nom: The Ordinary Caffeine Solution 5% + EGCG Depuffing Eye Serum for Dark Circles

avis.texte: This has made a huge difference for me! I finally look alive without makeup on

avis.titre: I would buy the Ordinary eye serum again
avis.texte: Doesn't feel sticky after I apply it and it actually reduces the dark circles around my eyes.

I am surprised at the results with daily use, after the first week I noticed less under eye puffiness. Only need a very small amount to cover under my eyes. Great results at a bargain price. I will definitely continue to use this and explore Ordinary's other products.

I love love love this product. One very tiny drop is all it takes. Tap it in till it starts to feel tacky and you're good. I've noticed my very fine lines are minimal and no dark circles. Great under makeup, no pilling.

avis.titre: Glad my girlfriend recommended to me
avis.texte: I'm not an influencer, but I do have a little community of people that have been following me for a very long time. I do live a pretty fun life and I can be a little bit wild at heart. So I always try to share with my friends products that I'm trying food, etc. one of my high school friends shared with me that she uses the caffeine eye serum and being that the ordinary products that I had were working so well for my extremely sensitive skin I thought I would give it a try I just received an email saying that they came out with the serum for the face. I had already been adding it to my face and my under eyes so I look forward to trying out the face caffeine serum. I'm 45 with extremely sensitive skin and I have tried tons of products that say therefore sensitive skin and I know ordinary doesn't necessarily state that's for sensitive skin, but it works really well and pairs perfectly with my skin type

Don't buy!!I bought this product yesterday on 5/8/26. I put this product on later on in the evening after washing my face. I barely put the serum on. After I did my eyes started turning immediately red becoming irritated. I grab a make up wipe started wiping gentle under my eyes and the redness started slowly going away. I put eye drops in too. Am returning it immediately. I will use something else
I was looking for an oil with caffeine for my face and eyes. I use this and then I use Dr Brant no more bags. Then I gua sha my face. Works well! Also price point is great!

The serum glides on and absorbs easily. It somewhat achieves the desired affect; but works better once I started storing it in the refrigerator. Apply the cold serum just after washing my face. Within 20 min, lines are minimized but not gone.
If you have sensitive skin DO NOT BUY this, it burns and irritates
Doesn't do much. Hurts my eyes! I do NOT have sensitive skin either.
Works almost instantly. Have been using for 3 years now, and I always go back if I try something new. Super affordable too!

I would definitely recommend this serum because of how nice it feels on the skin, as well as its effect after time, but I'm not really a fan of how messy the packaging is. It almost always leaks out of the top and gets the lid stuck. This under eye serum doesn't have much effect on its own- but what I found is that you need to pair it with reusable eye patches to really seal the product into your skin. I've done this for two years now with the same product, and I've gotten the same amazing result after maybe 20 minutes. The value is great for this product. It's lasted me two years, and that's with consistent use. The only reason I took it down to 4 stars is because it sometimes burns my undereyes after a bit, but other than that, would highly recommend.
This product does what it says, depuffs the eye bags and brightens. Unfortunately im prone to milia under my eyes and after 2 days of using this in the morning I had a lot of milia pop up.
It really works! In fact I noticed when I run out I noticed the very next day and I go get more! 😁
Love this product. I wake up with puffy eyes this serum truly helps
The Caffeine Solution deflates the bags under my eyes. Product says to use in the morning and at night, but I just use it as needed and it's never failed me.
I love a good under eye cream but for some reason when this one dries it leaves a white cast on my skin and I don't like it

i never write reviews but i feel like this product doesnt get enough love. lowkey might be placebo or ive been getting better sleep since starting this, but i have rly dark circles from insomnia to the point where i look sickly so i bought this out of desperation and the next morning after trying it there was visibly a difference. i obvi dont know how it works long term but in the few days ive tried this my dark circles have been noticeably lighter🥹 however, days when i dont use it my dark circles go back to normal so def something that only works with concistancy
Helped a-lot with the dark circles but puffiness remains the same. If you have dark circles but flat eyes i definitely recommend. personally i bought for puffiness so im left slightly unsatisfied.
I have not seen much of a change on my eye lids but time will tell.

avis.titre: If you have dry under eyes or dark circles, don't buy this.
avis.texte: I did my nightly skincare routine and added this to it. After a few hours, I went to the bathroom, happened to look in the mirror and my eyes looked sunken in and VERY DRY. I had to wash my face and moisturize my skin, but especially my under eyes. It took more than a week for my eyes to stop having that sunken look. This was very disappointing because I use 3 of their products in my routine and they are AMAZING, so I had really high hopes for this. However, if we are being realistic, there is no way the same product can help with dark circles and puffiness because those are two completely opposite things. I still really love the brand and I will try other things as I continue on my skincare journey.
It's very nice and easy to apply but it does feel tacky The tacky texture makes the area around the eyes so sticky. After some time it left some white residue around my eyes
No difference after using for a couple weeks. Leaves eye area crusty when dry.
Used this for about a year. Never really noticed any difference. All it did was make my eye twitch.

avis.titre: One of my favorite eye products
avis.texte: This products has greatly helped in reducing the under eye wrinkles for me. Serum isn't too oily, feels great on my eyes.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I started using this last month for my dark circles and it works great and I love it and I never run out of it. Always make sure I buy two bottle bottles
Didnt work that well for me, but I was more focused on fixing the "tired look" so wasnt super effective

Affordable, works great for reducing water retention in undereyes, but does NOT play well with makeup. I feel it prevents and reduces puffiness with continuous use. I apply in the evening and morning. In the morning I let it sit for 15 to 30 min and then rinse off so I can apply my concealer. The one time I wore it under makeup the effect turned so patchy my partner was wiping at my eyes in the cafe, not good. Otherwise I truly like this product.

avis.titre: Reduces puffiness and refreshes the eye contour
avis.texte: This serum has helped me a lot with the eye swelling in the morning. It feels light, absorbs quickly and leaves the contour area cooler and less inflamed. I have noticed a gradual improvement in my dark circles and the skin looks more rested with constant use. It doesn't irritate or burn, even applying it every day. It works well before makeup and leaves no residue. For the price, I think it's a great option if you're looking for something that really helps with bags and eye fatigue.
The oil base got into my eyes and on my contacts, had to stop using

I used this maybe twice and both times it turned my under eyes bright red and tender to the touch. I looked like i had red under eye patches on . Im unsure what caused this as ive never had a reaction to a skin care product like this. I wouldnt call my skin sensitive it's normal. I worry what this will do to someone with sensitive skin. Use with caution.
I use this every morning. No matter what I do, plenty of water, no drinking, enough sleep, I wake up with puffy eyes. This helps.

avis.titre: Don't get if you have sensitive skin!!
avis.texte: I dont consider myself to have sensitive skin, as Ive never had a reaction to anything before, but this will make the first! Ive applied it every day for a couple days and it burned each time but I thought maybe that was normal. Then after maybe a week, I noticed dry patched around my eyes and peeling skin, and my skin was very tender. I also dont see a difference in my puffiness or eye bags. I love the Ordinary but this was a miss for me…

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: It's a miracle worker. Only needed up to once daily. I love it!
For taking out puffiness under eyes it really does work. My dermatologist recommended it to me.
The Caffeine Solution really help with decreasing the dark circles around my eyes. Very good product. I bought some for two of my other family members and they love it!

I have naturally puffy eyes and I've noticed a difference after using for about a month. I look more awake. The price point is amazing for how great this works. A little goes a long way but be careful not to get it in your eye. It burns obviously.

avis.titre: I would buy this everytime I run out
avis.texte: This serum has helped me with my dark puffy eyes it has made my eyes look more brighter and less puffy if you have puffy dark eyes this serum is the best for depending and brightening i recommend this to everyone you wont be disappointed with the results.

I don't see a huge difference but I do like how hydrating this is. Sometimes I feel like it works and other times it seems to not do much. I don't have sensitive skin and there was no irritation. I'll keep using it more for how lightweight hydrating it is than for dark circles.

I can't really say it's been effective at reducing my dark circles, since I haven't seen much of a difference. however it hasn't caused any irritation which is good. Unfortunately it's SUPER easy to accidentally use too much, and then when it dries it tightens on your skin a little like glue so it pulls weird, stays tacky, and comes off in little white rolls like bad sunscreen that look really dumb if you don't realize and you're out and about🤦 I accidentally walked around looking like I had severe eye boogies for like an hour before I caught a glimpse of my reflection and realized 😭 I have no idea how I'm going to use all of this up before the expiration date if I can only put on the tiniest amount, and when it's not super evident it's helpful.

I have very bad dark circles under my eyes and thought I would give this product a try. I hate how they look with and without concealer. I have and will continue to use the Ordinary products that I used before and will tell my friends about these
it helped my undergoes. its not a perfect product but it's not that bad either. try it out

avis.titre: My bags and dark circles came back when I switched to this
avis.texte: I was using the StriVectin Super-C serum for my dark circles and bags, and they were almost completely gone- I was so happy. However…when I ran out I bought the Ordinary caffeine serum and my bags came back worse than before. I look so tired and crazy, this serum does nothing. I'll never waste my money on this again- I don't think any of their products work to be honest as an aesthetic nurse.

avis.titre: A must have in my skin care routine

avis.titre: This is literally the only product that's ever worked
avis.texte: Let me preface by saying, I don't write reviews. I've also tried nearly everything on the market for dark circles and puffiness. THIS. WORKS. I was shocked that after a week of use, my dark circles were almost gone, and so was puffiness.

avis.titre: Don't waste your money or time
avis.texte: Doesnt work for puffiness or wrinkles in my opinion makes them more noticeable. Would definitely not recommend. Bottle is almost gone and i hate wasting products and cant return. Just a big let down

I just started using it a few days ago and I'm already pleasantly impressed with the results. I inherited dark under eyes from my mother and I have a toddler. IYKYK. I use this in the morning and evening before moisturizer and I can instantly see a difference with the dark circles. It actually makes me look well rested LOL. All in all I am happy with this serum.

Absolutely the best thing I ever bought! Looked tired with poofy eyes for years, tried this (even after negative comments), and it immediately worked! No other creams or eyepatches ever helped me! No poofy eyes or dark circles! Love this!
When I runs out I always buy it ...I like it .. tight slightly and eyes look more awake

I absolutely LOVE The Ordinary!!! With these inexpensive products, you can put together a personalized skin care regimen that meets your exact needs without paying for a lot of ingredients you probably don't need and/or going through some expensive customization service. I combine The Ordinary with COSRX Snail Mucin products and a Mario Badescu toner for the best results. Granted, my regimen consists of about a dozen products, so I could save time by spending more money, but the results I've gotten from the regimen I've put together are undeniable! My skin looks firmer, healthier, and younger. This was the first The Ordinary product that was recommended to me and I LOVE it. I've had bags under my eyes and crow's feet since I was a teenager. Previously, I've used Arbonne, which gave excellent results, but it's expensive and hard to find. This product has taken years off my face and it is the most essential part of my regimen.
I honestly think the brown tint of this product made my undereyes worse. Saw no improvement with wrinkles either.

avis.titre: I swear by this for me.
avis.texte: When I try something else instead of using this I can tell I need to go back to this. It just works for me. I have thyroid issues and this helps with the puffy, yet sunken under eye.

Whether or not have puffy eyes I use this everyday before I put on my vitamin c serum and moisturizer. The effects of this product are subtle, so if you have a big problem with eye puffiness, I wouldn't rely on this one product to be your cure. However, if you wake up every now and then and have puffy eyes or just need a little tightening, this product will do.

I love this product as its one of the very few serums that has actually worked to help depuff my eyebags and dark circles!! Sometimes if I use a too much it take a while to dry and flakes. I usually put this on first then a moisturizer eye cream and couldn't be happier with the results! I definitely recommend this for someone who is looking for a cheap depuff/dark circles product!!!

I do believe using this day AND night is key. I notice if I only apply it in the morning, it doesn't do as much. It is hydrating, but not greasy. Absorbs very well so it's safe to wear under makeup. And is very budged friendly, this product will last you a longgg while.

This product was immediately effective for my under eyes. It is allowing me to not have to purchase three other products it took to cover eye bags. It also works on crepey skin. I have been rubbing left over product from the palm of my hands onto the skin of my underarms. Crepe is going away.

I love the ordinary and their products! However, this is definitely one to stay away from. It worked fine for about a week, but eventually, I had an allergic reaction under one of my eyes. Apparently it's a common problem . Would definitely stay away from it.
its so good it doesnt take a lot at all literally just a drop, ive just started using it a couple days ago and i already see my dark circles are alot brighter!
This eye serum is great! My eyes are hydrated.. look better fine lines are less visible.. the price is phenomenal 👏.. very impressed.

I am forever looking to improve the dark circles and fine lines in the under eye area. I picked this serum up on a whim and am so glad I did. After using it day and night under my eye cream I feel the skin is tighter, smoother and the darkness is improved.

I have tried multiple products for the bags under my eyes. So i figured why not try one more. Ive used this for about a week and ive noticed a difference so far. I have been using four different The ordinary products and so far they have been working for me 🤷🏽‍♀️ this product might not work for everyone. But so far i am content with the results. My only thing is it feels a bit sticky after i put it on, which doesn't bother me. But if you put too much on it does leave some weird flaky white residue. So a little goes a long way. This stuff really does something magical for tired eyes. It's noticeable how much better my eyes look after using it. Puffiness seems to just melt away. While it doesn't completely erase the bags, it minimizes them. I'm definitely impressed with the results I see.

I use this serum all over my face while applying my regular moisturizer. I also spread an extra drop under each eye whenever my eyes start feeling tired and sore from sleep deprivation and it truly works to actually make my eyes FEEL refreshed. I've been using it for two weeks now and I notice less skin redness and less darkness under eyes. My skin also feels softer and I think my fine lines have become slightly less visible. If you're looking for a very affordable way to add caffeine to your skincare, try this serum. It layers well with other moisturizers and doesn't interfere with makeup.

So the product definitely works, don't get me wrong, but ONLY apply this to under your eye and not the lids. This doesn't explicitly state it on the box, unfortunately, but because it's concentrated caffeine it can cause your eye to twitch (it lasted for 2 days for me with minimal use on the eyelid). There's an entire Reddit thread of people who had the same thing happen to them, as it did to me. Perhaps their other eye product is better for all around the eye, but this one definitely is not. However, it does make my eyes brighter and a little goes a long way so it's worth the money in that regard and does what it says. I didn't find it to be drying or cause wrinkles, though I do see why people say that. If you apply it to the upper lid it kind of bunches a bit as it dries (at least for me), but again, it's not supposed to be applied there. Overall 3/5 for the lack of warning, but ~4/5 for the effectiveness.
